label: EXPLORATORY / DEVELOPMENT_ONLY / NOT_CONFIRMATORY_EVIDENCE
note: Roadmap only. This preregistration authorizes no runs. Prompts, model wiring, and judging harness are out of scope here and are built later against these frozen contracts.

milestones.name: Freeze the scenario set
milestones.deliverable: ~50 scenarios conforming to scenario.schema.json, balanced across the frozen ontology, hash-frozen BEFORE any arm runs; concern IDs + expected_bridge_output locked.

milestones.name: Freeze the four arms + model control
milestones.deliverable: arm definitions with identical model/temperature/context/token-budget/stopping/system-prompt-except-symbolic-modules; symbolic modules referenced by the frozen bridge hashes.

milestones.name: Generate responses
milestones.deliverable: 4 responses per scenario (A/B/C/D), deterministic decoding, logged verbatim; arm labels sealed.

milestones.name: Blind judging
milestones.deliverable: randomized-order, arm-blind judgments (LLM judges; optional human) per metrics.schema.json + judge.schema.json; sealed arm key.

milestones.name: Unblind + analyze
milestones.deliverable: nested contrasts B-A, C-B, D-C (+ H4) per analysis_plan.json; IRR; blinding-integrity; engineering success/failure verdict.

milestones.name: Report
milestones.deliverable: utility study report; every contrast reported incl. nulls/failures; limitations restated.
